checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Breakfast mug is a noticeably darker, bluer teal and taller/narrower with a slimmer handle; the close-up is lighter sage. Colour is inconsistent.

must.item: Main image whole mug on pure white
must.why: Whole mug on clean white with a soft shadow.
Wooden table, toast, berries, warm light.

must.item: Detail focuses on rim and glaze
must.why: Rim and matte glaze are visible, though soft and out of focus.

faults.what: The breakfast-table mug is a darker teal-green than the sage mug in the white shot, and its proportions and handle differ. This is the very consistency the user was worried about.
The close-up is very soft and blurry, with weak glaze detail. Its sage shade matches image 1 better than image 2 does.

summary: The three images are clean, realistic and text-free, but the breakfast-table mug is a darker teal with different proportions, so the set does not read as one product.
